items.title: Bella Cornish Interview
items.q: All I know he used to be with Willie there, you know, play with him and all.

ctx.x: Do you remember anything else about Bob Lyons? He's dead now, but I thought we won't get to talk to him, of course. I wondered if you knew anything about his life.

No, I couldn't tell you nothing about Bob Lyons. All I know he used to be with Willie there, you know, play with him and all. But for me to have anything to say of him, I wouldn't know. I know he didn't worry with him too much, you know. My husband and them would be together with him. All the musicians used to be around there by Ruchacks. And used to be around there by Johnny Matoyas, where he's dead. You heard of him, eh? Certainly. When he died, Johnny Matoyas, he died. But he used to be there, because that's…
Where is Matoyas' place? He's all towed down.
